scenario.name: Tie-switch restoration
scenario.description: Same N03 fault as scenario 02, but 1s later the controller closes both tie lines (SW_N02_N05_TIE, SW_N04_N06_TIE) to restore N04, N05 and N06 through the alternate G01-N02-N05-N06-N04 path. Compare the restoration transient here against the permanently de-energized island in scenario 02.
